source_text.body:
Run newsletter and content repurposing with a voice agent
A voice agent hands work to n8n, which writes a daily AI newsletter, generates images, repurposes content into threads and video scripts, and does research.
·
Jul 29, 2025
Done with
N8
n8n
What they did
The setup used an ElevenLabs voice agent as the front end and a single webhook tool to pass full spoken requests into an n8n workflow. In n8n, an agent node with daily memory picked from custom sub-workflows such as writing the newsletter from scraped AI news, generating branded images, turning the newsletter into a Twitter thread and short-form script, creating a HeyGen avatar video, and running Perplexity-based research; the human mainly assigned work by voice and extended the system by adding new tools.
How it went
The poster says it now handles a daily AI newsletter with 10k subscribers plus repurposing, image generation, video creation, and research. The post presents architecture and a demo, but it does not give before-and-after time savings or quality benchmarks.
Worth knowing
A key implementation catch is the date-based memory key, which lets same-day follow-ups like “repurpose the newsletter” work with the earlier output.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Help me set up a content pipeline for my [topic] newsletter. Each day it should research the top [number] stories from [sources], write a newsletter draft in my voice using [sample past issue], and generate a header image idea. Then repurpose the draft into a thread and a short video script. Save everything as files in [folder] and stop for my review; do not publish or send anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/n8n/comments/1mch7p6/i_built_an_ai_voice_agent_that_replaced_my_entire
